name: rook
description: Real-time competitive pre-execution hedging market for autonomous agents

scripts.test: cross-env ROOK_RISK_LLM=off node --test --experimental-strip-types test/agents.test.ts test/bazantic.test.ts test/bazantic_benchmark.test.ts test/demo_rehearsal.ts test/slack_observer.test.ts
scripts.build:contracts: cross-env FOUNDRY_PROFILE=lowmem forge build --root swap-vm --skip test --skip script
scripts.test:all: npm run test:contracts && npm run test
scripts.e2e: npm run build:contracts && cross-env ROOK_RISK_LLM=off node --experimental-strip-types scripts/e2e-live.ts
scripts.demo: npm run build:contracts && cross-env ROOK_RISK_LLM=off node --experimental-strip-types scripts/demo.ts
